乔治·拉塞尔在巴库击败夏尔·勒克莱尔夺得杆位，此前积分榜领先者基米·安东内利在Q1戏剧性撞车，将从第16位发车；周六中午12点观看阿塞拜疆大奖赛，10:30开始预热，天空体育 F1和Main Event直播

乔治·拉塞尔以绝对优势夺得阿塞拜疆大奖赛杆位，而积分榜领先者基米·安东内利在Q1撞车，将从第16位发车。
拉塞尔在三节练习赛中状态极佳，并在Q3延续了强劲速度，以0.8秒优势击败法拉利的夏尔·勒克莱尔。
安东内利在Q1第一弯擦到内侧墙，尽管他努力继续并返回维修区，仍被要求在中段停车。

“所以是我的失误。非常不必要。说实话，我对此非常生气，明天会努力做得更好。”
这意味着当周六中午12点（10:30开始预热）灯光熄灭时，拉塞尔有很大机会大幅缩小与安东内利之间81分的差距，天空体育 F1和天空体育 Main Event直播。
“这可能是我整个职业生涯中最大的优势，甚至包括F2和F3时期，”拉塞尔说道，他自六月奥地利大奖赛以来还未获胜。

“这一圈感觉非常美妙。赛车整个周末感觉都很好，在这样的赛道上当你能够如此衔接时，感觉真的很棒。
基米·安东内利在阿塞拜疆大奖赛Q1撞墙
迈凯伦的奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里排位第三，这是他自七月底匈牙利大奖赛以来的最佳成绩，而红牛的伊萨克·哈贾尔在因手腕伤势缺席过去三个比赛周末后回归，位列第四。
马克斯·维斯塔潘看起来是拉塞尔杆位的真正威胁，但在Q3最后一轮飞驰圈中被兰多·诺里斯在第三弯锁死引发的黄旗所影响。
诺里斯仍将从第五位发车，但维斯塔潘仅排第八，落后于法拉利的刘易斯·汉密尔顿（第六）和阿尔派的皮埃尔·加斯利（第七）。

威廉姆斯本赛季首次进入Q3，卡洛斯·塞恩斯排位第九，但这位西班牙人因在黄旗下未减速（当时他冲出赛道）被罚退五位，将从第14位发车。
凯迪拉克的塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯排位第20，但因在Q1阻挡皮亚斯特里被罚退三位，而阿斯顿·马丁的费尔南多·阿隆索和兰斯·斯特罗尔因更换新动力单元部件将从队尾发车。
拉塞尔充分利用安东内利的失误
拉塞尔在周四的两节练习赛中均排名第一，但周五上午的最后一节练习赛中，维斯塔潘排名第一，车手们差距缩小。
感觉梅赛德斯在进入排位赛时仍是热门，但优势不大，Q1和Q2也印证了这一点，拉塞尔在两节中均排名第一，但受到维斯塔潘的强力挑战。
由于缺少高速弯，除迈凯伦外，大多数车队在Q3全程使用同一套轮胎，以使其进入更好的工作窗口。
皮亚斯特里在第一轮飞驰圈后暂列杆位，随后拉塞尔快了半秒，并在最后一圈找到更多速度，做出不可撼动的1:42.526，无人能接近。
天空体育 F1的卡伦·昌多克与乔治·拉塞尔一起回顾他在阿塞拜疆大奖赛的杆位圈
勒克莱尔，这位四次巴库杆位得主，排位第二，但仍落后0.837秒，而皮亚斯特里和哈贾尔基本发挥了赛车潜力，进入第二排。
诺里斯推得太猛，在第三弯冲入缓冲区，这也影响了维斯塔潘的圈速，但拉塞尔的惊人速度即使对安东内利来说也难以击败。
“已经有一段时间了，所以感觉很好。这可能是我整个职业生涯中最大的优势，甚至包括F2和F3时期，”拉塞尔说道。
“这一圈感觉非常美妙。赛车整个周末感觉都很好，在这样的赛道上当你能够如此衔接时，感觉真的很棒。
“最后就是完美的一圈。我身后与哈贾尔有很好的差距，这让我在这条后直道上获得了大概零点一到零点二的尾流，所以很棒。”
detailEn: Azerbaijan GP: George Russell claims Baku pole from Charles Leclerc as Kimi Antonelli crashes in Q1

George Russell beat Charles Leclerc to pole position in Baku after championship leader Kimi Antonelli dramatically crashed in Q1 and will start 16th; watch the Azerbaijan GP on Saturday at 12pm with build-up from 10.30am, live on Sky Sports F1 and Main Event
Highlights from qualifying for the 2026 Azerbaijan Grand Prix
George Russell claimed a dominant pole position for the Azerbaijan Grand Prix as championship leader Kimi Antonelli crashed in Q1 and will start 16th.
Russell had been in superb form throughout the three practice sessions and continued his mighty speed in Q3 to beat Ferrari's Charles Leclerc by eighth tenths of a second.
Antonelli clipped the inside wall into Turn 1 in Q1 and was told to stop the car in the middle sector, despite his efforts to carry on and get back to the pit lane.

"I turned in and had a lot more front end compared to the lap before and I touched the wall," explained Antonelli, whose perfect Q3 appearance record in 2026 came to an end.
"So mistake from my side. Very unnecessary. To be fair, I'm very mad about it and will try to do better tomorrow."

It means Russell has a big opportunity to make significant inroads into his 81-point deficit to Antonelli when the lights go out on Saturday at 12pm (build-up from 10.30am), live on Sky Sports F1 and Sky Sports Main Event.
"It's probably the biggest margin of my whole career, even including F2 and F3 days," said Russell, who has not won since June's Austrian Grand Prix.

"The lap felt really sweet. The car has been feeling great this weekend and on a track like this when you can hook it up like that it feels really amazing.
Kimi Antonelli hits the wall during Q1 at the Azerbaijan GP

McLaren's Oscar Piastri qualified third, his best result since the Hungarian Grand Prix at the end of July, while Red Bull's Isack Hadjar was fourth on his return from a wrist injury, having missed the last three race weekends.
Max Verstappen looked to be a genuine pole threat to Russell but was caught out by yellow flags which Lando Norris caused after locking up into Turn 3 on the last Q3 runs.
Norris will still start fifth but Verstappen is only eighth, behind Ferrari's Lewis Hamilton in sixth and Alpine's Pierre Gasly in seventh.
Craig Slater breaks down the Azerbaijan Grand Prix, including why the race takes place on a Saturday, while doing his best Craig David impression!

Williams reached Q3 for the first time this season as Carlos Sainz qualified ninth, but the Spaniard received a five-grid place penalty for failing to slow under yellow flags when went off, and will start 14th.

Cadillac's Sergio Perez qualified 20th but was handed a three-grid place penalty for impeding Piastri in Q1, while Aston Martin's Fernando Alonso and Lance Stroll will start at the back due to taking on new power unit elements.
Russell takes full advantage of Antonelli mistake
Russell had topped both of Thursday's practice sessions but the field closed up in final practice on Friday morning with Verstappen topping the session.
It felt like Mercedes were still favourites going into qualifying, but not by a big margin, and Q1 and Q2 underlined that as Russell topped both segments but was being pushed hard by Verstappen.
Due to the lack of high-speed corners, most teams apart from McLaren unusually ran the same set of tyres for the whole of Q3 to bring them into a better operating window.

Piastri took provisional pole after the first runs before Russell went quicker by half a second, then found even more pace on his last flying lap to set an unbeatable 1:42.526 which nobody came close to threatening.
Sky Sports F1's Karun Chandhok is joined by George Russell to watch back his pole-setting lap for the Azerbaijan GP
Leclerc, a four-time Baku pole-sitter, qualified second but was still 0.837s behind while Piastri and Hadjar largely maximised what they had underneath them to get onto the second row.
Norris pushed too hard and went deep into the run-off area at Turn 3, which also compromised Verstappen's lap but Russell's remarkable speed would have been tough even for Antonelli to beat.
"It has been a while so definitely feels good. It's probably the biggest margin of my whole career, even including F2 and F3 days," said Russell.
"The lap felt really sweet. The car has been feeling great this weekend and on a track like this when you can hook it up like that it feels really amazing.
"It was just the perfect lap at the end. I was in a good gap behind to Hadjar, which gave me a nice little slipstream probably by another tenth or two down this backstraight, so it was great."

勒克莱尔表示，在圣保罗大奖赛的练习赛中经历了“最糟糕的感觉之一”后，他将对赛车做出“大幅”设定调整。
勒克莱尔在第二次练习赛中落后最快车手安东内利零点七秒，汉密尔顿则落后近半秒，法拉利在周五的速度不及梅赛德斯、迈凯伦和红牛。
这与他们近期的表现形成反差，法拉利在最近四场比赛中都登上了领奖台，但勒克莱尔希望他们能在周六下午2点30分的第三次练习赛和下午6点的排位赛中扭转局面，天空体育F1频道将直播。

勒克莱尔表示：“第二节练习非常棘手。实际上，如果要说的话，这是我今年在车里感觉最糟糕的一次，所以有很多工作要做，而且感觉不太对劲。”
“我有一些想法。我们会大幅调整赛车，看看效果如何。我希望我们能向前迈进一步，因为即使我错过了第一节练习，我也不认为那里有多少性能可挖。”
“只是纯粹的速度不够好。”
查尔斯·勒克莱尔表示，在上周墨西哥城大奖赛与法拉利队友刘易斯·汉密尔顿发生冲突后，他已“解决”了两人之间的不和。
汉密尔顿全天都在努力让轮胎达到工作温度，这可能成为整个周末的大问题，因为周六下午排位赛预报有雨，而周日将非常寒冷，气温仅15摄氏度。
“这是充满挑战的一天。赛道非常颠簸且湿滑，这让轮胎很难进入正确的工作窗口，”汉密尔顿说。
“第一节练习整体还可以，但第二节练习更加困难。我们收集了大量有用数据，今晚将与车队一起梳理这些数据，弄清在排位赛前赛车可以在哪些方面改进。”
法拉利车队领队弗雷德·瓦塞尔在墨西哥事件后回答关于刘易斯·汉密尔顿和查尔斯·勒克莱尔的问题
勒克莱尔：成为父亲是最特别的事情
勒克莱尔的妻子亚历山德拉周三诞下女儿比安卡后，他晚些时候才抵达巴西。
这位29岁的车手成为当前发车区第五位当父亲的一级方程式车手，前四位是马克斯·维斯塔潘、费尔南多·阿隆索、尼科·霍肯伯格和塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯。
“这绝对是最特别的事情，”他说。
“你多少会期待这一刻，因为我一直想当个年轻爸爸，而且显然和亚历克斯在一起时，我们觉得时机对了，这是一个非常、非常特别的时刻。这一周绝对会因为我永远记住，全是积极的理由。
“当然，这期间也发生了其他事情。但对我来说，这一周全是关于比安卡的，真是太不可思议了。”

detailEn: Sao Paulo GP: Charles Leclerc plans 'significant' Ferrari car changes as Lewis Hamilton rues 'difficult' Brazil practice

Ferrari were off the pace compared to Mercedes, McLaren and Red Bull on Friday in Brazil with both Charles Leclerc and Lewis Hamilton unhappy about the car's balance; watch final practice at 2.30pm ahead Qualifying at 6pm live on Sky Sports F1 on Saturday
Highlights from Friday's practice sessions at the Sao Paulo Grand Prix
Charles Leclerc says he will make "significant" setup changes to his car after "one of the worst feelings" in practice at the Sao Paulo Grand Prix.
Leclerc was seven tenths off pace-setter Kimi Antonelli in second practice and Lewis Hamilton was nearly half a second behind as Ferrari trailed Mercedes, McLaren and Red Bull on Friday.

It was a contrast to their recent pace with Ferrari claiming a podium position in the last four races but Leclerc is hoping they can turn that around in final practice on Saturday at 2.30pm and qualifying at 6pm, live on Sky Sports F1.

"FP2 was very tricky. Actually, if anything, one of the worst feeling I've had this year in the car, so there's plenty to work on, and it didn't feel quite right," said Leclerc.

"I've got some ideas. We'll change the car quite significantly, and we'll see how it goes. I hope we can do a step forward because even though I missed FP1, I don't think there was much performance in that.
"It's just the raw pace wasn't great."

Hamilton struggled to generate tyre temperature throughout the day, something which could be a big issue throughout the weekend as rain is forecast for Saturday afternoon during qualifying, and Sunday will be very cold at just 15C.
"It was a challenging day. The track is very bumpy and slippery, which made it difficult to get the tyres into the right window," said Hamilton.

"FP1 was okay overall, but FP2 proved more difficult. We've gathered plenty of useful data, so we'll work through that with the team tonight to understand where we can improve the car ahead of qualifying."

Leclerc: Most special thing ever to become a father
Leclerc arrived late to Brazil after his wife Alexandra gave birth to a baby girl named Bianca on Wednesday.
The 29-year-old becomes the fifth Formula 1 driver on the current grid to be a father after Max Verstappen, Fernando Alonso, Nico Hulkenberg and Sergio Perez.
"It's definitely the most special thing ever," he said.

"You kind of expect it because I've always wanted to be a young dad, and obviously with Alex we felt like it was the right time, and it's a very, very special moment. Definitely a week I'll forever remember for all the positive reasons.
"Of course, there's been other things going on as well. But for me, this week was all about Bianca, and it's been it's been incredible."

圣保罗大奖赛周五练习赛精彩瞬间回顾。
作为F1新世界冠军，安东内利在赛道上完成了令人印象深刻的首日，并在圣保罗大奖赛第二场练习赛中设定了节奏。
在墨西哥成为该运动最年轻冠军五天后，安东内利在第一场练习中取得了第二快的成绩，并在蜿蜒的英特拉戈斯赛道上完成了更具代表性的第二场练习的最快成绩。
安东内利是唯一一位在圈速低于71秒的车手，他的基准时间1:10.763比最接近的挑战者兰多·诺里斯、P1的领跑者以及马克斯·维斯塔潘快了二十分之一秒。

但是，在周五的比赛中，诺里斯凭借自己最快的和第二快的成绩，也可以对自己的表现感到满意，因为麦凯轮车队对其MCL40赛车进行了升级。去年世界冠军，去年在圣保罗的获胜者，在长距离的比赛中也表现出色。
沃金车队是本周末唯一一支使用新部件的车队，他们试图在最后四轮比赛中反击红牛车队，在车队积分榜上超越对手，因为他们在维斯特潘在四场比赛中赢得三场胜利后，被对手超越了第三名。
乔治·拉塞尔紧随诺里斯和维斯特潘之后，在第二辆梅赛德斯赛车中排名第四快。他因为更换了新引擎，在本周末的比赛中将面临五位的发车位罚分。奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里在另一辆麦凯轮赛车中排名第六。
但是，对于法拉利来说，这似乎是赛道上的一个更艰难的第一天，尤其是在短距离的比赛中。
在墨西哥站第一圈发生碰撞导致车队失去了一次可能的胜利，并促使周四晚上车手与车队负责人弗雷德里克·瓦瑟尔举行会议以澄清情况后，刘易斯·汉密尔顿以第六快的成绩，查尔斯·勒克莱尔以第七快的成绩。
法拉利车队负责人弗雷德里克·瓦瑟尔在两位车手之间发生公开争执后，回答了关于刘易斯·汉密尔顿和查尔斯·勒克莱尔的问题。
勒克莱尔在错过周四的媒体日和周五的第一节练习后，在周一从摩纳哥飞回，因为他的第一个孩子比安卡出生。
奥迪车队的尼古拉斯·胡肯伯格是经验丰富的车手中之一，他缺席了新手的开幕式练习，而可靠性问题导致他整日没有完成任何一圈。
在第一节的比赛中，英国年轻车手弗雷迪·斯莱特在仅仅完成了七圈后遇到了技术问题，而车队在第二小时努力修理它时，一个电气问题使得赛车在剩余的时间里都无法参赛。

detailEn: Sao Paulo GP: Kimi Antonelli fastest for Mercedes in second practice at Interlagos ahead of Lando Norris in upgraded McLaren
Watch final practice at 2.30pm ahead Qualifying at 6pm live on Sky Sports F1 on Saturday
Highlights from Friday's practice sessions at the Sao Paulo Grand Prix.
Kimi Antonelli completed an impressive first day back on track as F1's new world champion to set the pace in second practice at the Sao Paulo Grand Prix.

Five days after becoming the sport's youngest title winner in Mexico, Antonelli followed up his second-fastest time from first practice with the quickest of the more representative second session around the undulating Interlagos lap.

Antonelli was the only driver to lap below 71 seconds with his benchmark time of 1:10.763 proving two tenths of a second quicker than nearest challengers Lando Norris, the P1 pacesetter, and Max Verstappen.

But with fastest and second-fastest times of his own from Friday, Norris can also be satisfied with his day after McLaren introduced an upgrade to their MCL40 cars. The outgoing world champion, last year's winner in Sao Paulo, appeared quick on the longer runs too.

The Woking team are the only team in the field with new parts this weekend as they bid to hit back against Red Bull in the Constructors' Championship over the final four rounds after being overtaken for third by their rivals after Verstappen's run of three wins in four races.

George Russell was close behind Norris and Verstappen to finish fourth fastest in the second Mercedes. He carries a five-place grid penalty for a fresh engine into the weekend. Oscar Piastri was sixth in the other McLaren.
But it appeared a more difficult first day on track for Ferrari, particularly on the short runs.

Following the first-lap clash that cost the team a likely victory in Mexico, and prompted a Thursday evening meeting between the drivers and team principal Frederic Vasseur to clear the air, Lewis Hamilton was sixth fastest with Charles Leclerc seventh.
Ferrari Team Principal Fred Vasseur answers questions about Lewis Hamilton and Charles Leclerc after a public spat between the two,
Leclerc returned to the track after missing Thursday's media day and then Friday's first session after flying back from Monaco following the birth of his first child, Bianca, earlier this week.
Audi's Nico Hulkenberg was among the experienced drivers to sit out the opening session for rookies and reliability problems meant he ended the day without a lap on the board at all.

A technical problem had already stopped British youngster Freddie Slater after just seven laps while he was in the car in the first session and, while the team worked to repair it for the second hour, an electrical problem kept it sidelined for the rest of the day.
